title: Grateful Dead Live at Philadelphia Civic Center on 1984-04-21
source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=137247)  Recording Info: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel > Dat (Panasonic SV-3800/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/48k; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller + AUD (shn id 10035) Recorded by Rob Eaton and Jeff Silberman -- Rob's Neumann u87 (cardiod setting, split 30', 17th row) > 6 x 9 volts > Teac mic transformers -> Jeff's Technics SV-100 line in @ 14 bits > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN; see info file for additional notes - matrix mixing by Kevin Tobin

ai_review.summary: Fine matrix recording captures a strong early‑84 performance that many rank among the year’s top shows.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers praise this April 21, 1984 concert as a standout of the year, calling it one of the top‑10 shows for ’84 and noting the band “rocked” throughout. Kevin Tobin’s matrix mix is highlighted as clean and well‑balanced, making the show enjoyable even without an original soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (4‑5 stars) and spoke positively about the performance; recording is described as a fine matrix, indicating good technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes a "fine matrix" and praises Kevin Tobin’s work in elevating the mix; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally praised as an energetic early‑84 set that ranks among the year's best, with the band consistently “rocking” throughout.
